summary: Iteration 107: Verified 3 P0 Bug Fixes - All Working Correctly. Backend: 13/13 tests passed (100%). Frontend: Dashboard, My Income, and Family Switching all functioning correctly with consistent data.
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard.py: monthlyExpenses/monthlyIncome derived from split totals (done+upcoming, received+expected) for perfect consistency
dashboard.py: _split_by_schedule_date() correctly handles Daily (current_day*amount) and Weekly (count_weekday_occurrences) expenses
expenses.py: monthly-summary spentSoFar uses count_weekday_occurrences for Weekly expenses matching dashboard logic
income.py: New /api/income/monthly-summary endpoint uses same calculation logic as dashboard for totalIncome/receivedIncome/pendingIncome
utils.py: count_weekday_occurrences() shared helper ensures consistent weekday counting across all endpoints
MyIncome.js: Now fetches from /api/income/monthly-summary backend endpoint instead of client-side calculations
FamilyContext.js: Auto-reset to personal view on navigation away from /home using useLocation + prevPathRef tracking
seed_data_creation: None - using existing test account data
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 bug fixes verified. Dashboard and My Income pages show consistent income/expense data. Family toggle works correctly - can switch to Priya Sharma and see member-specific view. Auto-reset to Personal happens when navigating away from /home.

expense_data_consistency.details: Dashboard monthlyExpenses matches /api/expenses/monthly-summary total. expensesDone + upcomingExpenses = monthlyExpenses. Tested with tz_offset=-330 (IST) and tz_offset=0 (UTC).

income_data_consistency.details: Dashboard monthlyIncome matches /api/income/monthly-summary totalIncome. incomeReceived matches receivedIncome. expectedIncome matches pendingIncome.

family_profile_switching.details: FamilyToggle shows 'Personal' dropdown on dashboard. Clicking 'Priya Sharma' switches to member view showing member's name in toggle, Net Worth=0, and 'No financial data yet' message. Works correctly.

my_income_page.details: My Income page shows 'Received' and 'Yet to Receive' values from backend /api/income/monthly-summary endpoint. Values match dashboard home page.

navigation_auto_reset.details: After switching to family member and navigating away from /home, returns to Personal view when coming back to /home.
